observations.content: Quarterly engineering report is due on the first Monday of each quarter, distributed to VP Engineering and CTO.
Report format: Executive Summary, Team Velocity, Incident Review, Infrastructure Costs, Next Quarter Goals.
Q1 2026 report is overdue — due date was 2026-04-06.
Team velocity data is stored in /tmp/brain-eval-c04/sprint-data.json.
Q1 velocity target was 120 story points per sprint across all teams.
Sprint data covers projects PLAT-*, API-*, INFRA-*.
Incident review section covers all SEV-1 and SEV-2 incidents from the quarter.
Incident data is stored in /tmp/brain-eval-c04/incidents.json.
Q1 2026 had 3 SEV-1 incidents and 7 SEV-2 incidents (estimated).
Infrastructure cost data is stored in /tmp/brain-eval-c04/cost-data.json.
Q1 cost target was $45,000/month; actuals for Jan and Feb were $47,200 and $46,800 respectively.
March cost data is available but hasn't been reviewed yet.
Executive summary should be 3-5 bullet points highlighting wins, risks, and key metrics.
Previous quarter's exec summary was praised for including trend charts alongside bullet points.
Next quarter goals section should include 3-5 OKRs with measurable key results.
Q2 planning data is stored in /tmp/brain-eval-c04/q2-planning.json.
Platform team handles PLAT-* and INFRA-* projects. Lead: Sarah Chen.
Platform team had 6 engineers in Q1 2026.
API team handles API-* projects. Lead: James Park.
API team had 4 engineers in Q1 2026.
